_comment: This file is the COMMITTED record of the latest GHCR-published image per
locally-built service. It is the source of truth the dashboard's read-only
'Update available' panel compares against the digests of the containers
How it is produced: the .github/workflows/publish-images.yml job builds +
pushes each service to GHCR on push-to-master / tag, captures the resulting
updated copy of this file back to master. Between releases this is simply a
frozen snapshot of the last publish.
The `digest` is the image manifest digest (sha256:…) returned by the
registry on push — the same digest you would pin with
git-SHA tag the same image also carries.
Until the first CI publish runs, digests are the empty-string sentinel and
the panel renders 'no published bundle yet — CI has not published to GHCR'.
Do NOT hand-edit digests; let CI own them.
